items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: You could leave Glenn take it over there too, Mr. T.

ctx.x: But if you have the picture while they'll be there, I'll run over you and get it.
Pick up the names and we can get them. Well, I'll tell you what we could do, Mama. You could leave Glenn take it over there too, Mr. T.

And let it stand there until you all get there. Yeah, until we get there. That's right. And then he can go back and get it. Because there might be somebody he has to think about on that. I saw a member of Shani's family and they're asking to give Shani's right name for me.
